what: Rebuilding a one-line bin after an edit on the same daemon fails: `linking target/debug/build/repro/<h>/out/repro: staging the change: linking: the function InstanceKey(56bcf0e7eca8) is removed, and Got(Address, Body(InstanceKey(56bcf0e7eca8))) still refers to it`. The edit: main() { println!("before") } -> println!("after"). A removed function still named by a GOT entry must drop or retarget the entry in the same patch, not refuse. Repro test: an_edited_crate_rebuilds_on_one_daemon in crates/blaze-engine/tests/repro.rs (crate under tests/repro/an_edited_crate_rebuilds_on_one_daemon/; the edit is in the test). It can hit the db lane segment.rs:367 panic first (queued separately); with that fixed this is what remains. Binary: self6 build (/Volumes/Projects/blaze-v2-self, 2026-10-31 ~18:58).
